description: Engine §6: named closes do not split erased classes under an aligned query with sealed identity comparisons.
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text $p:p
%conditions $p.without-elision.parse(w)
%rule p e e
%rule w $a:e $b:e
%conditions $a ≅ $b
%rule e a | b
%erased
%rule a A
%rule b A
